description.sr: Nastavnikov zapis uz pet dostavljenih fotografija: nazivi, imena autora, brojevi indeksa i podatak da su doneti prototipovi započeti na prvom času.
description.en: The teacher’s record accompanying five supplied photographs: titles, author names, student numbers and the statement that the brought prototypes were begun in the first class.

description.sr: Nastavnikova dopuna prethodne zbirke donetih prototipova: naziv i atribucija šestog rada uz dostavljenu fotografiju.
description.en: The teacher’s addition to the collection of brought prototypes: the title and attribution of the sixth work, with its supplied photograph.

description.sr: Nastavnik je potvrdio da doneti prototipovi i najavljeni naredni krug fotografija pripadaju drugoj nedelji. Drugi čas održan je u petak, 09.10.2026; nastava je petkom. Izrada prototipova započeta je na prvom času.
description.en: The teacher confirmed that the brought prototypes and the announced next batch of photographs belong to week two. The second class took place on Friday, 9 October 2026; classes meet on Fridays. The prototypes were begun in the first class.

description.sr: Nastavnikova dopuna druge nedelje: tehnički crtež Lego4ll sa izričitom atribucijom i četiri fotografije njegovog prototipa zvečke, dizajniranog u Blenderu i 3D štampanog. Crtež je zasebna vrsta rada; poreklo izrade i indeks nisu navedeni. Fotografije iz udruženja slede u zasebnom krugu.
description.en: The teacher’s addition to week two: the Lego4ll technical drawing with explicit attribution and four photographs of his rattle prototype, designed in Blender and 3D printed. The drawing is a distinct work type; the starting week and student number were not supplied. Photographs from the association will follow separately.

description.sr: Nastavnikova ispravka zbirke: fotografija isporučena za rad Zmijica prikazuje primer iz udruženja „Živimo zajedno”, donešen na prvi čas. Predmet pripada isključivo prvoj nedelji; atribucija studentu za ovu fotografiju je povučena. Fotografije iz posete udruženju se i dalje očekuju.
description.en: The teacher’s correction to the collection: the photograph supplied for the work Zmijica shows the association’s example, brought to the first class. The object belongs exclusively to week one; the student attribution for this photograph is withdrawn. Photographs from the association visit are still awaited.

description.sr: Ispravka voditelja predmeta: rad Zmijica je studentski rad, ne primer iz udruženja. Prethodna ispravka od 09.10. pogrešno ga je vodila kao pozajmljeni primer. Rad se dokumentuje u nedelji 2 sa ostalim studentskim prototipovima; sa prikaza gradiva prvog časa je sklonjen. Atribucija je vraćena na originalno dostavljenu studentsku prijavu.
description.en: The course lead's correction: the work Zmijica is a student work, not an association example. The earlier 9 October correction wrongly recorded it as a borrowed example. The work is documented in week 2 with the other student prototypes and is removed from the first class's material display. The attribution is restored to the originally supplied student record.

description.sr: Nalog voditelja predmeta uz isporučen materijal posete udruženju „Živimo zajedno”: 45 fotografija i tri snimka (10 s, 23 s, 5 s), nastalih 09.10.2026. između 13:54 i 14:11 po lokalnom vremenu. Za objavu su izabrane fotografije bez lica; snimci i ostale fotografije ostaju u radnoj svesci. Zapažanja posete upisana su uz pet radova; spisak studenata na poseti vodi registar posete (data/poseta.json).
description.en: The course lead’s instruction with the delivered material from the visit to the Živimo zajedno association: 45 photographs and three recordings (10 s, 23 s, 5 s), taken on 9 October 2026 between 13:54 and 14:11 local time. Photographs without faces were selected for publication; the recordings and the remaining photographs stay in the working notebook. Visit observations are recorded with five works; the list of students on the visit is kept in the visit register (data/poseta.json).

description.sr: Dopuna voditelja predmeta od 12.10.2026. (naveče): lica članova udruženja na fotografijama i snimcima mogu da se objave; natpisi „kadar bez lica“ se ukidaju i nema potrebe za njima; snimci se objavljuju uz nalaze. Imena korisnika i dalje se ne objavljuju, niti se lice vezuje za nalaz.
description.en: The course lead’s follow-up of 12 October 2026 (evening): the faces of the association’s members may be published in photographs and recordings; the “frame without a face” captions are withdrawn as unnecessary; recordings are published beside their findings. Members’ names are still not published, nor is a face tied to a finding.

description.sr: Ispravka voditelja predmeta od 12.10.2026. uz snimak ekrana: fotografija rada Zgradica objavljena je bočno — izvorna datoteka nosi EXIF orijentaciju 6, a izvedenica bez oznake prikazuje senzorsku orijentaciju. Bajti fotografije i otisak se ne menjaju; ispravka je samo prikazno polje „rotation: 90”.
description.en: The course lead’s fix of 12 October 2026 with a screenshot: the Zgradica photograph was published sideways — the source file carries EXIF orientation 6, and the derivative without the tag shows the sensor orientation. The photograph’s bytes and fingerprint stay unchanged; the fix is the display-only field “rotation: 90”.

description.sr: Digitalni prototip prikazan na laptopu: scena sa cvetovima različitih boja i oblika, uz oznaku „Žuti cvet“.
description.en: A digital prototype shown on a laptop: a scene of flowers in different colors and shapes, with the label “Žuti cvet” (“Yellow flower”).

alt.sr: Ekran laptopa prikazuje zelenu površinu sa raznobojnim stilizovanim cvetovima. Iznad scene stoje simbol note i tekst „Žuti cvet“; fotografija ne prenosi zvuk ili tok interakcije.
alt.en: A laptop screen shows a green field with colorful stylized flowers. A musical-note symbol and the words “Žuti cvet” appear above the scene; the photograph does not convey sound or the interaction sequence.

caption.en: Muzička Kutija — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Prostorna žičana putanja na kartonskoj podlozi, sa zelenim elementom na žici i izdignutim osloncima. Studentski prototip; dokumentovan u drugoj nedelji sa ostalim studentskim radovima.
description.en: A spatial wire path on a cardboard base, with a green element on the wire and raised supports. A student prototype, documented in week two with the other student works.

alt.sr: Savijena žica prolazi kroz zeleni element iznad kartonske podloge. Putanja ima petlje i promene visine, a oslonci su od slojevitog kartona i žute kartonske kutije.
alt.en: A bent wire passes through a green element above a cardboard base. The path has loops and changes in height, with supports made from layered cardboard and a yellow cardboard box.

caption.en: Zmijica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Višeetažna kartonska konstrukcija sa unutrašnjim pregradama, otvorima i belom lopticom.
description.en: A multilevel cardboard structure with internal partitions, openings and a white ball.

alt.sr: Otvorena kartonska konstrukcija ima više horizontalnih nivoa sa pregradama koje obrazuju prolaze. Na gornjoj površini je kružni otvor, na nižem nivou bela loptica; rukom se pridržava prednja ivica.
alt.en: An open cardboard structure has several horizontal levels with partitions forming passages. A circular opening is visible on the upper surface and a white ball on a lower level; a hand holds the front edge.

caption.en: Zgradica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Kartonske ploče sa tamnim kvadratnim poljima i svetlim, izdignutim ciframa. Fotografija beleži fizički raspored elemenata.
description.en: Cardboard boards with dark square cells and light-colored raised numerals. The photograph records the physical arrangement of the pieces.

alt.sr: Dve kartonske ploče na stolu podeljene su u kvadratna polja. Na tamnim površinama nalaze se ručno izrađene reljefne cifre od svetlog kartona; deo ploča izlazi iz kadra.
alt.en: Two cardboard boards on a table are divided into square cells. Hand-cut raised numerals in light cardboard sit on dark surfaces; parts of the boards extend outside the photograph.

caption.en: Sudoku — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Obojeni delovi kartonske ambalaže i podloga sa oznakama boja. Na fotografiji se delovi rukama raspoređuju uz podlogu.
description.en: Colored pieces of cardboard packaging and a base marked with colors. Hands are arranging pieces beside the base in the photograph.

alt.sr: Podloga od kartonske ambalaže za jaja ima izdignute vrhove sa obojenim oznakama. Oko nje su odvojeni delovi obojeni žuto, plavo, roze, crveno, zeleno, belo i ljubičasto; ruke drže dva dela.
alt.en: An egg-carton base has raised peaks marked with colors. Separate pieces around it are painted yellow, blue, pink, red, green, white and purple; hands hold two pieces.

caption.en: Pogodilica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Otvorena kartonska kutija sa narandžastim cilindričnim elementima i dvema crnim šipkama iznad njih. Na fotografiji se rukom pridržava žuti predmet.
description.en: An open cardboard box with orange cylindrical pieces and two black rods above them. A hand holds a yellow object in the photograph.

alt.sr: U otvorenoj kartonskoj kutiji nalaze se tri narandžasta cilindrična elementa, iznad kojih prolaze dve crne šipke. Ruka delimično zaklanja levi element i pridržava žuti predmet.
alt.en: An open cardboard box contains three orange cylindrical pieces with two black rods above them. A hand partly obscures the left piece while holding a yellow object.

caption.en: Upadalica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Tehnički crtež dizajna: prostorni prikaz kvadratne podloge sa mrežom i kružnim i izduženim elementima, uz izdvojene delove i projekcije. Rad je dokumentovan kao crtež, a ne kao izrađen prototip.
description.en: Technical design drawing: a spatial view of a square gridded base with circular and elongated elements, alongside separate components and projections. The work is documented as a drawing, not as a fabricated prototype.

alt.sr: List sa prostornim prikazom kvadratne mreže, kružnih i izduženih delova, kao i zasebnim projekcijama.
alt.en: A sheet showing a square grid, circular and elongated parts in perspective, with separate projections.

caption.sr: Lego4ll — tehnički crtež. Fotografija je snimljena uspravno; prikazana je okrenuta da se crtež čita vodoravno.
caption.en: Lego4ll — technical drawing. The photograph was taken upright; it is shown rotated so the drawing reads horizontally.

description.sr: Nastavnikov prototip zvečke, dizajniran u Blenderu i izrađen 3D štampom. Četiri fotografije prikazuju kružne forme u plavoj, žutoj i crvenoj boji, koncentrične elemente i različite površinske detalje.
description.en: The teacher’s rattle prototype, designed in Blender and fabricated by 3D printing. Four photographs show circular forms in blue, yellow and red, concentric elements and different surface details.

alt.sr: Plavi kružni 3D štampani elementi sa koncentričnim prstenovima i reljefnim detaljima na podlozi štampača.
alt.en: Blue circular 3D-printed elements with concentric rings and raised details on the print bed.

caption.sr: Plavi primerci — detalj koncentričnih elemenata i teksture.
caption.en: Blue examples — detail of the concentric elements and texture.

alt.sr: Krupni plan plavog kružnog elementa sa reljefom u sredini i prstenovima oko njega.
alt.en: Close view of a blue circular element with a raised centre and surrounding rings.

caption.sr: Plavi primerak — pogled na središnji detalj.
caption.en: Blue example — view of the central detail.

alt.sr: Žuti kružni element na podlozi 3D štampača, sa prstenovima i nizovima otvora u površini.
alt.en: A yellow circular element on the 3D printer bed, with rings and rows of openings in the surface.

caption.en: Yellow example on the 3D printer bed.

alt.sr: Više plavih, crvenih i žutih kružnih štampanih primeraka među nitima filamenta.
alt.en: Several blue, red and yellow circular printed examples among strands of filament.

caption.sr: Zbirni pogled na štampane primerke u različitim bojama.
caption.en: Collected view of printed examples in different colours.

summary.sr: Korisnica je sama navlačila zeleni element po žičanoj putanji, pritežući podlogu drugom rukom; rad je korišćen na stolu, bez usmeravanja.
summary.en: A user pulled the green element along the wire path by herself, steadying the base with her other hand; the work was used at the table, without prompting.

alt.sr: Dve ruke iznad žičane putanje: desna ruka navlači zeleni element po žici, leva pridržava kartonsku podlogu sa žutim osloncem na stolu.
alt.en: Two hands over the wire path: the right hand pulls the green element along the wire, the left steadies the cardboard base with a yellow support on the table.

caption.sr: Zmijica u rukama korisnice — poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Zmijica in a user’s hands — association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Na snimku od deset sekundi čuje se brojanje naglas do pogotka i aplauz; kutiju sa štapićima istovremeno drže dva para ruku.
summary.en: On the ten-second recording a user counts aloud up to the drop, followed by applause; two pairs of hands hold the box with the sticks at once.

alt.sr: Četiri ruke oko kartonske kutije sa štapićima: žuta loptica visi iznad narandžastih čašica, prsti podešavaju razmak.
alt.en: Four hands around the cardboard box with sticks: a yellow ball hangs above the orange cups, fingers adjust the gap.

caption.sr: Upadalica — dva para ruku, jedan pogodak; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Upadalica — two pairs of hands, one drop; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Pločice sa reljefnim brojevima slagane su i razvrstavane po stolu; kontakti su bili kraći i mirniji nego kod ostalih radova — slaganje bez utrke.
summary.en: Tiles with raised numbers were laid out and sorted on the table; the contact was shorter and quieter than with the other works — arranging without a race.

alt.sr: Ruke slažu crne pločice sa belim reljefnim brojevima na stolu, pored razvrstanih pločica.
alt.en: Hands lay out black tiles with white raised numbers on the table, beside sorted tiles.

caption.sr: Sudoku — slaganje pločica sa brojevima; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Sudoku — laying out the numbered tiles; association visit, 9 October 2026.

alt.sr: Sto sa crnim pločicama sa reljefnim brojevima; ruka upravo vraća pločicu u red.
alt.en: A table with black tiles with raised numbers; a hand is just returning a tile to the row.

caption.sr: Sudoku — pločice na stolu; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Sudoku — tiles on the table; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Tabla sa obojenim stošcima igrana je sa više strana stola istovremeno; po broju fotografija, najposećeniji rad posete.
summary.en: The board with coloured cones was played from several sides of the table at once; by photograph count, the most visited work of the visit.

alt.sr: Tabla gledana odozgo: ruke slažu obojene stošce i figurice u polja sa rupicama.
alt.en: The board seen from above: hands place coloured cones and figures into the holes.

caption.sr: Pogodilica — grupa oko table; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Pogodilica — a group around the board; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Aplikacija za praćenje pokreta na laptopu: korisnik diže i spušta ruku ispred ekrana i dobija zvučni i slikovni odziv; posmatrano i otpozadi.
summary.en: A hand-tracking application on a laptop: the user raises and lowers a hand in front of the screen and receives a sound and visual response; also seen from behind.

alt.sr: Korisnik posmatran otpozadi sedi za stolom ispred laptopa; ruka mu je podignuta ispred ekrana.
alt.en: A user seen from behind sits at the table in front of a laptop; a hand is raised in front of the screen.

caption.sr: Muzička Kutija — pokret ispred ekrana, posmatrano otpozadi; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Muzička Kutija — a movement in front of the screen, seen from behind; association visit, 9 October 2026.

alt.sr: Ruka ispred ekrana laptopa na kom aplikacija cvetom odgovara na pokret.
alt.en: A hand in front of the laptop screen where the application answers the movement with a flower.

caption.sr: Muzička Kutija — odziv aplikacije na pokret ruke; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Muzička Kutija — the application’s response to a hand movement; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Na snimku od 23 sekunde korisnica pomera i okreće zgradu: loptica prolazi kroz rupu sprata i spušta se naniže, uz aplauz u pozadini. Fotografija je iz istog trenutka — rad je probavan i na krevetu, tamo gde je korisnik.
summary.en: On the 23-second recording a user shifts and turns the building: the ball passes through a floor’s hole and drops lower, with applause in the background. The photograph is from the same moment — the work was tried on the bed too, where the user was.

alt.sr: Korisnica drži žuto-beli toranj Zgradice objema rukama; otvorena prednja strana pokazuje unutrašnjost spratova sa rupama kroz koje se loptica spušta.
alt.en: A user holds the yellow-and-white Zgradica tower with both hands; the open front shows the floors’ interiors with the holes the ball drops through.

caption.sr: Zgradica — loptica i rupa na svakom spratu; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Zgradica — a ball and a hole on every floor; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Drugi kadar istog trenutka: igra sa osmehom, sa plakatom udruženja u pozadini.
summary.en: A second frame of the same moment: play with a smile, the association’s poster behind.

alt.sr: Korisnica sa osmehom navlači zeleni element po žičanoj putanji; u pozadini sto i poster udruženja na zidu.
alt.en: A smiling user pulls the green element along the wire path; behind her the table and the association’s poster on the wall.

caption.sr: Zmijica — igra sa osmehom; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Zmijica — play with a smile; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Drugi kadar istog trenutka: pažljivo nameštanje jednog stošca, uz ostale učesnike oko stola.
summary.en: A second frame of the same moment: carefully placing a single cone, with the other participants around the table.

alt.sr: Korisnik u kačketu pažljivo namešta stožac na tabli sa rupicama; oko stola ostali učesnici posete.
alt.en: A user in a cap carefully places a cone on the pegged board; around the table the other visit participants.

caption.sr: Pogodilica — strpljenje u jednom potezu; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Pogodilica — patience in a single move; association visit, 9 October 2026.

summary.sr: Drugi kadar istog trenutka: podignuta ruka, osmeh i odziv aplikacije na pokret.
summary.en: A second frame of the same moment: a raised hand, a smile, and the application’s answer to the movement.

alt.sr: Korisnik u kačketu podiže ruku ispred laptopa sa osmehom; aplikacija cvetom odgovara na pokret.
alt.en: A user in a cap raises his hand in front of the laptop with a smile; the application answers the movement with a flower.

caption.sr: Muzička Kutija — pokret koji se čuje; poseta udruženju, 09.10.2026.
caption.en: Muzička Kutija — a movement that is heard; association visit, 9 October 2026.

alt.sr: Dve kartonske ploče na stolu podeljene su u kvadratna polja. Na tamnim površinama nalaze se ručno izrađene reljefne cifre od svetlog kartona; deo ploča izlazi iz kadra.
alt.en: Two cardboard boards on a table are divided into square cells. Hand-cut raised numerals in light cardboard sit on dark surfaces; parts of the boards extend outside the photograph.

caption.en: Sudoku — supplied photograph of the prototype.

sta.sr: Potvrđena dokumentacija rada u nedelji 2; početak izrade u nedelji 1 ostaje sačuvan.
sta.en: Confirmed documentation in week 2; the start of making in week 1 is preserved.

description.sr: Obojeni delovi kartonske ambalaže i podloga sa oznakama boja. Na fotografiji se delovi rukama raspoređuju uz podlogu.
description.en: Colored pieces of cardboard packaging and a base marked with colors. Hands are arranging pieces beside the base in the photograph.

alt.sr: Podloga od kartonske ambalaže za jaja ima izdignute vrhove sa obojenim oznakama. Oko nje su odvojeni delovi obojeni žuto, plavo, roze, crveno, zeleno, belo i ljubičasto; ruke drže dva dela.
alt.en: An egg-carton base has raised peaks marked with colors. Separate pieces around it are painted yellow, blue, pink, red, green, white and purple; hands hold two pieces.

caption.en: Pogodilica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.sr: Otvorena kartonska kutija sa narandžastim cilindričnim elementima i dvema crnim šipkama iznad njih. Na fotografiji se rukom pridržava žuti predmet.
description.en: An open cardboard box with orange cylindrical pieces and two black rods above them. A hand holds a yellow object in the photograph.

alt.sr: U otvorenoj kartonskoj kutiji nalaze se tri narandžasta cilindrična elementa, iznad kojih prolaze dve crne šipke. Ruka delimično zaklanja levi element i pridržava žuti predmet.
alt.en: An open cardboard box contains three orange cylindrical pieces with two black rods above them. A hand partly obscures the left piece while holding a yellow object.

caption.en: Upadalica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

sta.sr: Prema nastavnikovoj ispravci, fotografija isporučena za ovaj rad prikazuje primer iz udruženja „Živimo zajedno” donešen na prvi čas, a ne studentski prototip. Atribucija studentu je povučena; rad se dokumentuje u nedelji 1 kao pozajmljeni primer. Ako postoji istoimeni zasebni studentski rad, čeka sopstvenu fotografiju.
sta.en: Following the teacher’s correction, the photograph supplied for this work shows the association’s example brought to the first class, not a student prototype. The student attribution is withdrawn; the work is documented in week one as a borrowed example. If a separate student work of the same name exists, it awaits its own photograph.

description.sr: Prostorna žičana putanja na kartonskoj podlozi, sa zelenim elementom na žici i izdignutim osloncima.
description.en: A spatial wire path on a cardboard base, with a green element on the wire and raised supports.

alt.sr: Savijena žica prolazi kroz zeleni element iznad kartonske podloge. Putanja ima petlje i promene visine, a oslonci su od slojevitog kartona i žute kartonske kutije.
alt.en: A bent wire passes through a green element above a cardboard base. The path has loops and changes in height, with supports made from layered cardboard and a yellow cardboard box.

caption.en: Zmijica — supplied photograph of the prototype.

description.en: A spatial wire path on a cardboard base, with a green element on the wire and raised supports. An example borrowed from the association “Živimo zajedno”; the teacher brought it to the first class as a starting point for students designing their own prototypes.

sta.en: Zmijica is a student work (attribution restored to the originally supplied student record), not an association example. The work is documented in week 2 and removed from the first class's material display.
